subject: general
question: Jamshedi Navroz is a festival of _________ community.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parsi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jamshedi Navroz** is celebrated by the **Parsi** community.
 
• It marks the **Persian New Year** and is celebrated with great enthusiasm among Parsis.
 
• The festival falls on the **spring equinox**, around March 21st, and symbolizes rebirth, renewal, and rejuvenation.
 
• Parsis observe this day by cleaning their homes, wearing new clothes, and preparing special meals.
 
• The celebrations often include visiting the **fire temple** to offer prayers and seek blessings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Parsi community in India is primarily concentrated in **Mumbai** and **Gujarat**.
 
• Jamshedi Navroz is named after the legendary **King Jamshed** of Persia, who is credited with starting the Parsi calendar.
 
• The festival is also known as **Nowruz** in other parts of the world, including Iran and Central Asia.
 
• It is a day for Parsis to reflect on the past year and make new resolutions for the coming year.
 
• Traditional Parsi dishes such as **patra ni machhi** (steamed fish), **ravo** (sweet semolina pudding), and **falooda** (a sweet drink) are commonly prepared for the occasion.
